concept_thesis: Settings as an object browser: every setting and resource is a read-only record in a sortable, filterable ledger; a persistent right inspector is the only editing surface (control, provenance chain, requested-vs-effective diff, evidence, reset, caution gating). Zero motion by identity.

plan_owner_impacts.impact: Storage & Retention and Backup & Restore render as record collections: retention classes with a legal-hold pin, pressure states (elevated baseline, critical under fx.storage-pressure), quarantine with reasons, compaction/migration status, and the four backup kinds kept visibly distinct (internal recovery snapshots, settings backup, project backup, full Server backup). Restore points carry per-point verification state including the pending verification on tank/backups. Test restore is scratch-only with hash verification. The plan should adopt the four-kind vocabulary and the verified/pending restore-point state.

Artifacts are records with PM-owned vs provider-native identity as a first-class labeled field, redaction states (applied/pending/none) with an apply action, retention incl. an expired cleanup candidate, and honest open/reveal/export/clean receipts. The panel plan should confirm the identity split and redaction lifecycle.
Artifact location is always a vault path; version and producedBy (session id) are part of the record grammar; receipts link every artifact to the run that produced it.

Worktrees are records with three states (leased with holder+expiry, idle, stale cleanup candidate). Leases are a hard boundary: prune is disabled while leased, cleanup dry runs report the skip explicitly. Test-before-merge, force-push never (safety floor), protected branches, and 90-day reflog recovery render as policy records. The EGOLITE section IA (Overview / Repositories / Git & Jujutsu / Hosting Services / Accounts & Sign-in / Execution Environments / Worktrees / Safety / Automatic Updates / Diagnostics) is adopted verbatim.

Settings owns pinning, readiness, and setup only; run/log depth stays in the left-rail GitHub Actions panel (boundary note rendered in-manager). Pinned workflow records show passing/failing with failed-job detail and log excerpts in the inspector; offline disables refresh with an honest reason. Forges CONNECT (never install); GitHub connected as jared-platyr with scopes and per-capability availability.

Three human top-level resources (Docker / Podman / Kubernetes tools) with component detail (engine/cli/compose/buildx/socket; kubectl/helm) in the inspector only. Registries carry auth-as-vault-reference and a cert-warning state with trust guidance (add CA vs LAN-only trust). Unraid publishing is a connected record with template count.

Installation records expose the full resolution chain (configuredCommand -> resolvedLauncher -> actualExecutable), method, package identity, manager root, host/environment, arch, discovery evidence, and five-level confidence. Unknown/ambiguous confidence is manual-only and the resolver (PMProvider.resolveInstallation) drives the action list — the UI offers no manage actions the resolver does not.

Update lifecycle rendered with the full state set; verification checklist (seven conditions) shown during verify/failed/rolled-back; 'installer exit code 0 is never success' is literal UI copy; copilot two-entry history records verification-failed then rolled-back. The Updates destination for the PM app itself stays reserved to this owner.

Proves the three-pane record+inspector composition at narrowAt 1120 with zero-motion identity: CSS declares no animations/transitions, withInstantMotion forces instant jumps, operation phases render as instant state changes. Adds the title-bar notification stack as sole in-app notification surface (via shared shell).

Uses the packet's new rows (system.storage.*, system.backup.project-schedule, system.maintenance.import-export, system.health.diagnostics-verbosity, extensions.web.fetch-size-limit) as ordinary setting records inside managers. Note: system.health.diagnostics-verbosity is defined in the shared dataset but grafted into no taxonomy sub; c4 falls back to the home all-records table for its deep link — the inventory owner should assign it a canonical subcategory.

Provider records now include installations as sub-records, auth boundary from PMProvider.resolveAuthBoundary (Claude/Antigravity cli-owned, OpenAI/Copilot pm-direct-oauth), cursor-cli explicit official-source install offer with exact host picker and install-is-not-sign-in copy, OpenCode external-server record (serverInfo; server owns credentials, PM holds scoped token reference), ollama usage-unavailable-but-ready, free-route six-state vocabulary, free catalog freshness records with change history, and role-level requested-vs-effective diffs (role-batch-reviewer) in the inspector's diff panel.

Twelve traces contributed in candidate-wiring-delta.json; all concept_local_state:true. The import preview/apply/rollback chain, backup-now, test-restore, cleanup dry-run with lease skip, index rebuild, actions refresh, registry add with cert warning, worktree prune gated by lease, and installation update happy/fail paths each carry recovery deep links.

The connected-server card, project card (Hosted On / Project Files / Run Work), execution hosts/environments (WSL Off healthy, setup only on capability demand, Windows native complete without WSL), paired clients, and the nine reserved destinations each naming owner + insertion contract. No backend state machines invented.

plan_owner_impacts.summary: Coordination authority reviewed after the original packet omitted it. Concepts align to: RuntimeResourceGovernor as the sole resource/admission owner (no concept invents a second governor); ObservableWork as the sole truthful progress projection (op events now carry progressKind, source, completed/total only with a real denominator, and waitReason); the seven-execution-lane model, hot/warm/cold state, low-resource/legacy profile, and lazy Settings opening model (register sections 2, 7, 8, 11, 13, 20) as Slint-port constraints recorded in slint_port_impacts and test fixtures.

settings_schema_impacts.impact: Schema needs an import transaction object: staged preview (counts, conflicts with local/incoming, invalid keys with reasons, legacy migrations from->to), merge|replace mode, staged restore-point reference, atomic apply phases (restore-point/applying/verifying), and a rollback record that references both directions. Secrets are excluded structurally, not by convention.

Restore points need typed kind (recovery|settings|project|server), origin (pre-import|schedule|manual), verification state (verified|pending|failed), and target dataset. Settings rows that participate in imports reference the staging restore point.
Every one-shot action result carries a receiptId; records render receipts as chips/kv with stable ids (rcpt.*). Rollback receipts record both directions.
The action vs setting vs status vs manager distinction is schema-level: c4 renders each with an explicit kind tag; the schema should type them rather than leaving it to copy.

schema_event_storage_impacts.impact: PMState 'op' events ({name, ref, phase}) are the truthful ObservableWork projection; c4 renders them as instant phase strips. Production needs the same phase event stream per operation with stable phase vocabularies (declared in OP_PHASES).

Concept-local persisted keys: view (validated at boot; falls back if it names moved managers), fixtures, scenario, hist.deletion, import.choice.<settingId>. Namespaced under pm.settingsConcepts.fable.c4-ledger.

Demo op events aligned to the ObservableWork contract: progressKind (determinate|indeterminate), progress source (measured|derived|unknown), completed/total emitted only when a real denominator exists (bare percentages are stripped at the emitter), waitReason from the register's waiting_* vocabulary where applicable (e.g. waiting_resource on rate-limited test sends, waiting_for_idle surfaced through installation update states). Production schema should adopt the full state grammar: accepted..recovery_required.

migration_supersession_impacts.by: Destination index + record ledger; cmd.settings.bloom.open retired (see command delta).

migration_supersession_impacts: Fabricated percentages in progress displays (register sections 11 and 16.6): the index-rebuild fixture previously emitted invented pct values; it now emits an honest indeterminate scanning phase followed by measured file counts.
Startup discovery scans implied by copy (register section 13): the skills-discovery row description no longer claims a startup scan; discovery is bounded and demand-driven.

slint_port_impacts.impact: lg-root maps to a HorizontalLayout of navigator / document / inspector panels; the inspector is a separate pane component fed by a selected-record model, never an overlay. Narrow mode (<1120) swaps to drawer + bottom sheet — in Slint, conditional layout on width.

The home all-records table and every record section must be ListView-style virtualized models; c4's lazy materialization (40 rows, +60 per page) is the web stand-in. Sections are a flat section+row model for one continuous Flickable.

Requested-vs-effective and local-vs-incoming diffs are a reusable two-row+why component; phase strips are a Row of state-styled labels bound to the op-phase model. Zero-motion: no animations required anywhere, which makes the concept trivially portable.
Usage stacked bar and progress bars are width-weighted rectangles over models; no transitions.

unresolved_questions: system.health.diagnostics-verbosity has no taxonomy sub in the shared dataset — which subcategory canonically owns it (system/health vs system/maintenance)?
Should conflict decisions in the import preview (keep local vs take incoming) persist inside the staged transaction object or as separate audit rows? c4 stores them concept-locally per settingId.
Does 'Back Up Now' default to the settings kind (as here) or prompt for kind when multiple manual-backup kinds are eligible?
Worktree prune of an idle (non-stale) worktree: allowed with confirm (as here) or gated behind a stale threshold?
Registry LAN-only trust: is that a first-class trust scope in the certificate model, or an allowlist entry under Permissions?
Cleanup apply granularity: whole dry-run report at once (as here) or per-category apply with separate receipts?

Register section 23 calibration gates recorded, not claimed: 825+-setting search responsiveness, 100 detected installations collapsed to human summaries, Settings Home with all manager summaries plus exactly one lazy-hydrated manager, and old-hardware (Ivy Bridge/Xeon) / poor-network operation are implementation benchmarks; the demo proves the design shapes (humanized collapse, lazy hydration, cached-catalog-first copy) but measures nothing.
